purpose: Run the existing EvidenceLab C/C++ CWE-120 or CWE-121 evidence families against external source corpora and preserve auditable outputs.

supported_importers: SecVulEval JSON/JSONL/Parquet manifests produced by EvidenceLab importers
inputs.raw_dataset_policy: External raw datasets are not bundled in this pack. Keep licensed data outside the source repository and preserve provider terms.

required_stages: Acquire dataset artifacts from an authoritative source and verify registry SHA-256 where available.
Import source records while preserving record IDs, labels, dataset identity, commit and provenance metadata.
Audit input manifest cardinality, label census, source paths and source hashes.
Capture each selected source case with Joern and preserve capture failures as explicit uncertainty/failure records.
Build a corpus using EvidenceLab research-build and retain split and quality reports.
Materialize the corpus into self-contained directories for the currently supported evidence families.
Run research-check once to collect metrics and a second time with strict publication gates.
Review independent-source identity, cluster diversity, source/graph leakage, label authority, witness replay and confidence intervals before making any research claim.
outputs: Imported manifests and a source-safe census report
Build report and captured benchmark/graph artifacts
Materialization report and self-contained family benchmarks
Metrics report without strict gate enforcement
Explicit nonzero exit status when strict gates fail
